# generated/ — probe-produced fixtures

Copy of one `dvg_probe` run (devilutionX pinned at
`ca91d778fba92a1f680afb1fb2cdf09337ff1b42`; see tools/probe/README.md):
`manifest.txt` lists every artifact's sha256. Refresh: `just fixture-refresh`;
verify: `just fixture-verify`.

Subdirs: `dun/`, `frames/`, `lighttables/`, `rng/`, `save/` — see each
subdir's README for what it contains. Root files are the committed probe
inputs: `demo_0.dmo` (scripted timedemo), `seeds.txt` (seed list).
